swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: AP62200WU-7 (TSOT-23-6) vs TPS54302DDCR (SOT-23-6) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 47% (AP62200WU-7: 750 kHz p.5 vs TPS54302DDCR: 400 kHz p.5); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP62200WU-7: 3.3 µH p.17 vs TPS54302DDCR: 10 µH p.18); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (AP62200WU-7: 0.8 V p.5 vs TPS54302DDCR: 0.596 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP62200WU-7: 18 V p.4 vs TPS54302DDCR: 28 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP62200WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS54302DDCR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 41% (AP62200WU-7: 70 °C/W p.4 vs TPS54302DDCR: 118.9 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: AP62200WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and TPS54302DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to switching frequency differs >30%; recommended inductor value differs >20%; feedback reference voltage Vref differs. Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency is 750 kHz (p.5) vs 400 kHz (p.5), rated current is 2000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 10 µH (p.18), and Iq is 135 µA (p.5) vs 45 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 70 vs 118.9 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
